tv_wonder_set_required_progress_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_unit_required_progress value = 300000 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_unit_required_progress value = 100000 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 2 }

tv_wonder_detect_existing_wonder_at_saved_site_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_construction_site_selected_trigger = yes }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain
						has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_foundation
						has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_body
						has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_function
						has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_decoration
						has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary
						has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_ascetic_mountain
						has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_theocratic_center
					}
				}
				prev = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_locked value = 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary }
					prev = {
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ceremony_style value = 1 }
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ceremony_locked value = 1 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_ascetic_mountain }
					prev = {
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ceremony_style value = 2 }
						set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ceremony_locked value = 1 }
					}

			location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_eternal_lighthouse value >= 4 }
			NOT = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_great_lighthouse value >= 4 } }
		}
			if = {
				limit = { always = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_great_lighthouse } }

tv_wonder_scan_priority_proposal_effect = {
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_priority_found
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_proposal_site
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_proposal_mode
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_priority_declined } }
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { NOT = { prev = { has_variable = tv_wonder_priority_found } } }
			save_scope_as = tv_wonder_priority_site
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { prev = { has_variable = tv_wonder_priority_found } }
					OR = {
						has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_foundation
						has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_body
						has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_function
						has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_decoration
						AND = {
							has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain
							NOT = {
								OR = {
